# OvZuno Crypto

Independent technical publication about crypto payment infrastructure, stablecoin settlement, self-custodial wallets, crypto cards, PayFi, security, and compliance.

Publisher: https://ovzuno.com/
Editorial standards: https://crypto.ovzuno.com/editorial-standards/
Disclosure: https://crypto.ovzuno.com/publication-disclosure/
Contact: editor@ovzuno.com
Status: pre-launch; pages are not intended for search indexing.
